Brazil's #1 song out-streamed America's #1 last week: 9.6M vs 8.6M on Spotify. 🇧🇷

"Postinho de Gasolina" by João Gustavo e Murilo (with Grelo) sits at #1 on Spotify's Brazil weekly chart for the week of Oct 8, 2026: 9,598,401 streams, up 23% on the week, 52.0M total after 9 weeks. The US #1, Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero", did 8,579,862 in the same week.

The whole Brazil Top 50 moved 174.0M streams. Zé Neto & Cristiano put 3 songs on it for 12.5M streams, Murilo Huff has 4 songs (11.7M), and MC Jvila and Mc Jacaré lead the funk side. Two different songs are both called "Flash - Ao Vivo" and both are climbing: Hugo & Guilherme (#4, up 14) and Lucas & Higor (#42, up 25).

Which Brazilian artist should we break down next? 👇

Full breakdown on our page.

Data: Spotify Weekly Charts (Brazil, US) via kworb.net · week of Oct 8, 2026
